name: Handwoven Straw Fedora Hat
description: Handwoven straw fedora hat with a wide brim and a thin leather band. The breathable material keeps you cool, and the classic shape adds a touch of summer elegance. Perfect for beach outings or garden parties.
shortDescription: Handwoven straw fedora with wide brim.

reviews.title: Disappointed with flimsy straw
reviews.comment: The handwoven straw felt cheap and fell apart after one wear. The fedora brim was misshapen and offered no sun protection.

reviews.title: Poor quality, not worth price
reviews.comment: The straw material was brittle and the hat lost its shape quickly. The stitching came undone after a short walk.

reviews.title: Average hat, decent but flawed
reviews.comment: The handwoven straw gives a nice rustic look, but the brim is a bit too narrow for full coverage. It feels comfortable but the size runs slightly small.

reviews.title: Perfect summer accessory, love it!
reviews.comment: The handwoven straw fedora is lightweight and fits just right, providing great shade on sunny days. The craftsmanship is impressive and the natural color complements my outfits beautifully.

reviews.title: Terrible hat, fell apart instantly
reviews.comment: The straw fibers were already frayed when I opened the package, and the fedora collapsed after I tried it on. I expected better durability for the price.
